title: John Snow cholera graph before the instrument
content: Figure 7.7 shows why the observed Water Purity-Cholera association is confounded before Water Company is introduced: hidden miasma, poverty, and related conditions cause both water purity and cholera.

variables.name: Miasma, Poverty, etc.
variables.content: The unobserved common causes of water purity and cholera.

variables.name: Water Purity
variables.content: The treatment whose causal effect is sought.
